name: vix_adjusted_mean_reversion_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms (pension funds, FIIs executing large program orders) aggressively fade intraday deviations from session VWAP, but their activation threshold scales with current VIX. In low-VIX regimes (< 14), NIFTY's compressed realized vol makes even a 20-30 spot point deviation from VWAP statistically anomalous (z-score ~1.0), triggering immediate algo-driven fading within 30-60 seconds. In high-VIX regimes (> 20), those same institutions require 60-80 spot point deviations (z-score ~2.5+) before fading because intraday noise is genuinely wider and smaller deviations are not statistically significant. By scaling the entry z-score threshold dynamically with VIX — entering only when the deviation is anomalous relative to the current volatility regime — we isolate the conditions where the reverting institutional force is strong enough to produce a measurable 30-90 second bounce on the index.

indicators.name: vwap_session
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume) since session open (reset per day)
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP from 09:15 — cumulative measure, no lookback scaling needed. This is the reversion anchor: VWAP-benchmarked institutional algos treat this as their execution benchmark throughout the day.

indicators.name: vwap_zscore
indicators.purpose: Z-score of VWAP deviation using 240-bar (20 min) rolling stddev. 20 minutes captures enough intraday price action to estimate current session vol without being anchored to the open. Shorter stddev window (e.g. 60 bars/5 min) over-reacts to brief spikes; longer (720 bars/60 min) misses intra-session regime changes. The entry signal fires when this z-score crosses the VIX-scaled adaptive threshold.

indicators.name: adaptive_threshold
indicators.purpose: VIX-scaled entry threshold — current VIX reading only, no historical lookback needed. Maps VIX 12 → threshold 1.0, VIX 22 → threshold 2.0, clipped at [0.8, 2.5]. Directly implements the original strategy's core innovation: aggressive entries in calm markets (small deviations are truly anomalous) and selective entries in volatile markets (need genuine dislocation).

indicators.name: rsi_24
indicators.purpose: 2-minute RSI (24 bars × 5s) for entry confirmation. Original used RSI(14) on 1-min bars = 14 min of context. Compressed to 24 bars (2 min) because we're trading a 30-90s reversion — we need to confirm that FAST momentum (last 2 min) is exhausted, not just slow momentum. A 14-min equivalent (168 bars) would be too lagged to confirm intraday turning points at 5s resolution.

conditions: rsi_24 < 40 (momentum oversold — confirms dislocation not a slow trend down)
zscore_delta > 0 (zscore turning up — reversion has started, not still deepening)
vix_close < 25 (absolute panic cap — above 25 dislocations become disorderly)
buy_ce.confirmation: zscore_delta > 0 (current z-score higher than previous bar — bounce initiation)

conditions: rsi_24 > 60 (momentum overbought — confirms dislocation not a slow trend up)
zscore_delta < 0 (zscore turning down — fade has started)
buy_pe.confirmation: zscore_delta < 0 (current z-score lower than previous bar — fade initiation)

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points (≈8 NIFTY spot points at delta ~0.5). If mean reversion is correct, the bounce begins within 30s. A 4-pt option loss means NIFTY has moved 8+ spot points FURTHER from VWAP after our entry — deviation is accelerating, not reverting, and the thesis is wrong. Calibrated just above the 2-5 pt noise range for a 30s NIFTY move so we avoid stopping out on brief fluctuations while cutting quickly if wrong.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option points (≈14 NIFTY spot points). A z-score > adaptive_threshold deviation on NIFTY typically represents a 30-60 spot point dislocation from VWAP. The first-leg reversion within 30-90s covers approximately 20-30 spot points (half the deviation), which is 7-10 option points at delta ~0.5. We target 7 pts (lower end) to maximize hit rate — the full journey back to VWAP takes minutes but we only need the initial institutional fading impulse.

filters.vix_filter: vix_close < 25 — above 25 NIFTY dislocations become chaotic; market makers withdraw and the reverting institutional force is absent
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:25 IST — skip first 5 min pre-open noise; VWAP stddev needs 20 min to stabilize
filters.volume_filter: none — index volume on 5s bars is erratic; signal driven purely by price structure
filters.trend_filter: none — mean reversion strategy; zscore_delta confirmation already prevents entering mid-trend
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close prices, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — VWAP-benchmarked institutional execution is structural to how large orders are worked in Indian markets; VIX-adaptive thresholds are more robust to regime change than fixed thresholds

adaptation_notes: Original ran on top-25 Nifty50 stocks at 1-min bars, targeting 10-60 min mean reversions. Converted to NIFTY index for three reasons: (1) VWAP-to-VIX interaction is even stronger at index level where institutional program orders dominate; (2) Index is more symmetric for CE/PE entry; (3) Index VWAP is cleaner than single-stock VWAP (no earnings gaps, corporate events). Key changes: (a) stddev lookback: 60 1-min bars → 240 5s bars (20 min) — same calendar time; (b) RSI: 14 1-min → 24 5s (2 min) — compressed because hold time reduced 10x; (c) added zscore_delta confirmation to avoid catching falling knives; (d) VIX cap retained at 25; (e) hold time: 10-60 min → 30-90s — only the initial institutional fading impulse, not the full VWAP journey.
weaknesses: VWAP z-score near session open (first 20 min of trading) has unreliable stddev — denominator is small and noisy; warmup period needs to be respected
On strong trending days driven by sustained FII flow, VWAP constantly drifts directionally and z-score thresholds will trigger repeatedly against trend (catching falling knives)
Linear VIX-to-threshold mapping (0.1 per VIX point) is an approximation; the true relationship is likely nonlinear and may differ in different market regimes
zscore_delta confirmation is a 1-bar filter (5 seconds) which may still enter mid-move if the initial reversal bar is followed by continuation

_source.original_stop: 1.5 * adaptive_threshold in z-score terms OR 1.5 * ATR(20) in price terms
